title: A planner you can write in
description: Handwritten plans and stickers next to calendar events. Personal notes survive when a meeting changes its time.

blocks.text: A paper page lets you add a thought beside the plan, but a meeting in a digital calendar has to be moved separately. In moving to a screen, you want to keep the freedom of writing without keeping the schedule twice.

quote.text: I was always a paper planner girl. But lugging around a paper planner in my purse was getting taxing. This planner made the transition much easier and honestly, I am spending a lot less even with the annual fee.

blocks.text: Link the day’s page to the calendar events, and store the handwritten notes separately from where they sit on the grid. When a meeting moves, offer to move the notes attached to it or to leave them at the old date.
Test moving an event with real handwritten notes on it. If the note you need disappears or stays unnoticed at the old date, pretty stickers do not solve the main problem.
